concepts.title: Promotion: Identification of Business Opportunity
concepts.definition: Promotion is the first stage of company formation in which the promoter conceives the business idea, investigates its feasibility, assembles resources and takes steps to set up the company, and the promoter stands in a fiduciary position towards the company.
concepts.key_idea: The promoter performs discovery of the idea, detailed investigation, financing, assembling the business unit and entering into preliminary contracts before incorporation.

solution_steps.explain: Note the person conceiving and setting up the company.

concepts.title: Incorporation: Registration Documents and Certificate
concepts.definition: Incorporation brings the company into legal existence through registration with the Registrar of Companies by filing the memorandum of association, articles of association, declaration and the prescribed fee, after which a certificate of incorporation is issued granting the company its birth.
concepts.key_idea: From the date of the certificate of incorporation, the company becomes an artificial person with separate legal entity and perpetual succession.

solution_steps.explain: Recall memorandum, articles, declaration and fee.

State the rights gained on incorporation.

concepts.title: Capital Subscription: SEBI and Minimum Subscription
concepts.definition: After incorporation the company raises capital through public subscription, requiring a name approval earlier, securities from SEBI, filing of prospectus or statement in lieu of prospectus, minimum subscription, and allotment of shares after the application money is received.
concepts.key_idea: Minimum subscription is the minimum amount stated in the prospectus that must be raised before allotment, and SEBI regulates the disclosure and investor protection norms of public issues.

solution_steps.explain: Confirm SEBI registration of the issue documents.
Recall prospectus or statement in lieu of prospectus.
Check minimum subscription before shares are allotted.

concepts.title: Commencement of Business
concepts.definition: A public company must obtain a certificate of commencement of business by filing the statement of share capital and a declaration that minimum subscription has been raised before it can start operations or borrow, while a private company can begin business after incorporation.
concepts.key_idea: The certificate of commencement of business is the final licence that lets a public company start its operations.

solution_steps.explain: Check whether the company is public or private.
Recall the statement of share capital and declaration.
Confirm the certificate before business begins.
